preconditions.description: The length of the permutations is between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: Each number from 1 to n occurs exactly once in each permutation.
preconditions.description: Each number in the permutations appears exactly once.
It is guaranteed that there is a sequence of swaps that will transform permutation p into permutation s.

postconditions.expression: The output must contain the minimum number of coins required to transform permutation p into permutation s.
postconditions.description: The first line of the output contains the minimum number of coins required to transform permutation p into permutation s.

postconditions.expression: The output must contain the sequence of swap operations that achieves the minimum number of coins.
postconditions.description: The second line of the output contains the number of operations needed to get the solution.

postconditions.expression: Each operation must be a valid swap of two elements in the permutation.
postconditions.description: Each line of the output after the second contains a pair of numbers i and j, which means that you need to swap p_{i} and p_{j}.
